mentions.name: Denorm
mentions.description: Denorm is a tool that materializes derived columns in PostgreSQL databases, both within and across tables, with guarantees for termination, no race conditions, non-subvertibility, and concurrency. Released under the Apache license, it addresses a class of business logic problems the author has faced since the 1990s.
mentions.problem: Solves a class of business logic problems around maintaining derived data in relational databases.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just finished up Denorm release 1 a couple of hours ago.  It solves a class of biz logic problems I've faced since the 90s. Materializes derived columns in Postgres databases, within and across tables.   Termination, no race conditions, non-subvertible, concurrency.
